title: Pyaar Ka Ehsaas
author: MyeKitab
description: Ek dil ko chhoo lene wali prem kahani, jisme do dilon ke beech ka safar dikhaya gaya hai jo mushkilon se guzarta hai aur anth mein pyaar ki jeet hoti hai.
preview: Raat ka andhera dheere dheere shahar ko apne aagosh mein le raha tha, aur Riya khidki ke paas khadi, dur tak failey aasman ko dekh rahi thi. Uske zehan mein sirf ek hi naam gunj raha tha...

title: Gaon Ki Kahani
author: MyeKitab
description: Gaon ke jeevan, rishton aur sanskaro ki saral lekin bhavnatmak kahani.
preview: Subah ki pehli kiran jab gaon ke khet-khaliyan par padi, tab se hi Ramu kaka apne kaam mein jut gaye the...

title: Adhuri Mohabbat
author: MyeKitab
description: Woh mohabbat jo kabhi poori nahi ho payi, lekin jiski yaadein aaj bhi dil mein zinda hain.
preview: Kuch kahaniyan adhuri reh jaati hain, lekin unki khushboo hamesha ke liye reh jaati hai...

title: Rahasya Ki Raat
author: MyeKitab
description: Ek raat, ek raaz, aur ek such jo sabka jeena mushkil kar deta hai.
preview: Jab ghadi ne baarah baje, tab darwaze par khadi ek saaya nazar aayi...

title: Hasrat
author: MyeKitab
description: Zindagi ki wo hasrat jo har kisi ke dil mein chhupi hoti hai.
preview: Har shaam, Meera apni chhat par baith kar doob te suraj ko dekhti thi...
